candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care, p. 22 — Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement).
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — performance improvement and quality improvement
candidate.educational_objective: Participate in quality improvement by using client-care data and evidence, collaborating in approved improvement actions, and evaluating whether the intervention improves client outcomes.

options.A: Review unit data and relevant evidence with the quality team, participate in an approved improvement plan, and evaluate its effect on client outcomes
options.B: Change the unit fall-prevention policy independently after reviewing a single fall event and evaluate the change only if another fall occurs
options.C: Document each fall in the individual medical record but avoid using aggregate unit data because quality improvement is limited to management staff
options.D: Wait for an accrediting organization to prescribe the intervention before reporting the unit trend or participating in corrective action

candidate.rationale: The 2026 NCSBN NCLEX-RN Test Plan includes Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement) within Management of Care. RN activities include participating in performance-improvement projects, reporting identified client-care issues, using research and other references for improvement actions, and evaluating the impact of improvement measures on client care and resource use. Option A incorporates these functions. The other options either bypass organizational processes and adequate evidence, exclude the RN from quality improvement, or delay reporting and action while waiting for an external body.
candidate.source_claim_supported: The RN participates in quality-improvement processes by reporting care issues, using evidence for improvement actions, and evaluating the effect of improvement measures on client care.
candidate.source_locator: Management of Care, p. 22, Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement): participate in performance-improvement projects and quality-improvement processes; report identified client-care issues; utilize research and other references for performance-improvement actions; evaluate the impact of performance-improvement measures on client care and resource use.
candidate.source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
candidate.stem: A medical-surgical unit identifies an increase in client falls and begins a performance-improvement project. Which action by the RN best reflects the nurse's role in this process?
